title: 超解析螢光顯微鏡
summary: 從 Abbe 繞射極限出發，理解結構照明、STED 與單分子定位如何利用頻率混合與螢光開關繞過它，再把損耗飽和、染料佔空比與標記密度、TIRF 背景與相機雜訊、漂移與焦距鎖定、解析度預算與 FRC、技術選擇與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的超解析系統工程。
summaryEn: Start from the Abbe diffraction limit to see how structured illumination, STED and single-molecule localization bypass it with frequency mixing and fluorescence switching, then integrate depletion saturation, dye duty cycle and labeling density, TIRF background and camera noise, drift and focus lock, resolution budgets and FRC, technique choice and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable super-resolution system record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: dSTORM 預算練習：λ = 670 nm、NA = 1.49，PSF 標準差 s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm，樣品端像素 100 nm，每次閃爍 N = 1000 光子。TIRF 背景 b = 3 時 Thompson 精度 σ ≈ 3.4 nm，EMCCD 過量雜訊乘 √2 得 4.8 nm。取 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s，23 nm/min 的漂移累積 77 nm，以金粒子校正後殘差 1.5 nm。一抗加二抗連結 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm，總 σ ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM ≈ 23 nm。此解析度需標記 ≥ 7.3×10³ 個/µm²，每個 0.0625 µm² 繞射面積約 456 個標記，佔空比須 ≤ 2.2×10⁻³；染料佔空比 10⁻³ 時約 3000 幀可讓 95% 標記至少亮一次。若改用 STED 達到同樣 23 nm，需 I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: dSTORM budget exercise: λ = 670 nm and NA = 1.49 give a PSF standard deviation s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm, with 100 nm sample-side pixels and N = 1000 photons per blink. With TIRF background b = 3 the Thompson precision is σ ≈ 3.4 nm, and EMCCD excess noise multiplies it by √2 to 4.8 nm. Acquiring 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s, a drift of 23 nm/min accumulates 77 nm, corrected with gold fiducials to a 1.5 nm residual. With 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration the total σ ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM ≈ 23 nm. That resolution needs ≥ 7.3×10³ labels/µm², about 456 labels per 0.0625 µm² diffraction area, so the duty cycle must be ≤ 2.2×10⁻³; with a dye duty cycle of 10⁻³ about 3000 frames let 95% of labels light at least once. Reaching the same 23 nm with STED would need I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「繞射極限與三種繞過策略」與「STED 損耗飽和與解析度定律」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 繞射極限與三種繞過策略：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The diffraction limit and three ways around it: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「繞射極限與螢光開關」如何決定超解析螢光顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統螢光顯微鏡的光學轉移函數在空間頻率 2NA/λ 截止，比 λ/(2NA) 更細的結構傳不到相機。超解析方法不是打破繞射，而是繞過它：結構照明（SIM）以已知條紋與樣品頻率混合，把截止外的資訊以摩爾紋搬進通帶，解析度約提升 2 倍；STED 以損耗光強迫焦點周圍的分子回到暗態，只留下中心的奈米發光區；單分子定位（PALM/STORM）讓分子在時間上輪流亮起，每次只有稀疏的分子發光，再以擬合求中心，精度約 s/√N。三者分別以線性光學、確定性切換與隨機切換換取解析度，速度、光劑量與標記要求各不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「繞射極限與螢光開關」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The optical transfer function of a conventional fluorescence microscope cuts off at spatial frequency 2NA/λ, so structure finer than λ/(2NA) never reaches the camera. Super-resolution methods do not break diffraction but go around it: structured illumination (SIM) mixes a known fringe pattern with sample frequencies, moving information beyond the cutoff into the passband as moiré and gaining about a factor of 2; STED uses a depletion beam to force molecules around the focus back to a dark state, leaving a nanoscale emitting centre; single-molecule localization (PALM/STORM) lets molecules light up in turn so only sparse emitters glow at once, then fits their centres with precision near s/√N. The three trade linear optics, deterministic switching and stochastic switching for resolution, at different costs in speed, dose and labeling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ = 520 nm、NA = 1.4：Abbe 極限 λ/(2NA) ≈ 186 nm，截止頻率 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At λ = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 the Abbe limit λ/(2NA) is ≈ 186 nm and the cutoff 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超解析顯微鏡突破了繞射定律。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Super-resolution microscopes break the laws of diffraction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「繞射極限與螢光開關」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：超解析顯微鏡突破了繞射定律。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「繞射極限與三種繞過策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The diffraction limit and three ways around it" is correct?
options: 超解析顯微鏡突破了繞射定律。
傳統螢光顯微鏡的光學轉移函數在空間頻率 2NA/λ 截止，比 λ/(2NA) 更細的結構傳不到相機。

The optical transfer function of a conventional fluorescence microscope cuts off at spatial frequency 2NA/λ, so structure finer than λ/(2NA) never reaches the camera.
STED resolution depends only on depletion power; more is always better.
quiz.explanation: 傳統螢光顯微鏡的光學轉移函數在空間頻率 2NA/λ 截止，比 λ/(2NA) 更細的結構傳不到相機。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The optical transfer function of a conventional fluorescence microscope cuts off at spatial frequency 2NA/λ, so structure finer than λ/(2NA) never reaches the camera. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 繞射極限與三種繞過策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The diffraction limit and three ways around it: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「繞射極限與螢光開關」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = 520 nm、NA = 1.4：Abbe 極限 λ/(2NA) ≈ 186 nm，截止頻率 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹。SIM 以 488 nm 激發條紋最高 5.74 µm⁻¹，延伸支援 5.38 + 5.74 = 11.1 µm⁻¹，約 90 nm。110 nm 週期結構（9.09 µm⁻¹）與 200 nm 條紋（5.0 µm⁻¹）混頻成 4.09 µm⁻¹、週期 244 nm 的摩爾紋，落在通帶內。定位：PSF 標準差 s ≈ 94 nm、N = 1000 光子時理想精度 s/√N ≈ 3.0 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At λ = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 the Abbe limit λ/(2NA) is ≈ 186 nm and the cutoff 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹. SIM with 488 nm excitation fringes reaches at most 5.74 µm⁻¹, extending support to 5.38 + 5.74 = 11.1 µm⁻¹, about 90 nm. A 110 nm period structure (9.09 µm⁻¹) mixed with 200 nm fringes (5.0 µm⁻¹) yields 4.09 µm⁻¹ moiré of 244 nm period, inside the passband. For localization, a PSF standard deviation s ≈ 94 nm and N = 1000 photons give an ideal precision s/√N ≈ 3.0 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 100 nm 以下的螢光珠在寬場模式量 PSF 並求 OTF 截止頻率，確認接近 2NA/λ；同一樣品以 SIM 重建後在傅立葉譜上確認支援範圍擴大到約兩倍；在固定的稀疏單分子樣品上重複定位同一分子 100 次，量位置標準差並與 s/√N 比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the PSF of sub-100 nm beads in widefield and derive the OTF cutoff, confirming it is near 2NA/λ; reconstruct the same sample with SIM and confirm in the Fourier spectrum that support has roughly doubled; on a fixed sparse single-molecule sample localize one molecule 100 times, measure the positional standard deviation and compare with s/√N.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

SIM with 488 nm excitation fringes reaches at most 5.74 µm⁻¹, extending support to 5.38 + 5.74 = 11.1 µm⁻¹, about 90 nm. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「繞射極限與三種繞過策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The diffraction limit and three ways around it", which statement holds?
options: 只要光子夠多，背景高低不影響定位精度。
定位精度就是超解析影像的解析度。

optionsEn: With enough photons, background does not affect localization precision.
Localization precision equals the resolution of the super-resolution image.
At λ = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 the Abbe limit λ/(2NA) is ≈ 186 nm and the cutoff 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹.

quiz.explanationEn: At λ = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 the Abbe limit λ/(2NA) is ≈ 186 nm and the cutoff 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 繞射極限與三種繞過策略：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The diffraction limit and three ways around it: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「繞射極限與螢光開關」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 100 nm 以下的螢光珠在寬場模式量 PSF 並求 OTF 截止頻率，確認接近 2NA/λ；同一樣品以 SIM 重建後在傅立葉譜上確認支援範圍擴大到約兩倍；在固定的稀疏單分子樣品上重複定位同一分子 100 次，量位置標準差並與 s/√N 比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the PSF of sub-100 nm beads in widefield and derive the OTF cutoff, confirming it is near 2NA/λ; reconstruct the same sample with SIM and confirm in the Fourier spectrum that support has roughly doubled; on a fixed sparse single-molecule sample localize one molecule 100 times, measure the positional standard deviation and compare with s/√N. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 SIM 重建影像上的細紋當成超解析結構，實際上是條紋頻率或相位估計錯誤造成的蜂巢狀或條紋狀重建假影；研究者把假影解讀為新的蛋白排列，直到論文被質疑才發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Fine lines in a SIM reconstruction are taken as super-resolved structure when they are honeycomb or stripe artefacts from wrongly estimated fringe frequency or phase; researchers interpret the artefact as a new protein arrangement and discover the error only when the paper is challenged.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「繞射極限與三種繞過策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The diffraction limit and three ways around it"?
options: 以 100 nm 以下的螢光珠在寬場模式量 PSF 並求 OTF 截止頻率，確認接近 2NA/λ。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。
optionsEn: Measure the PSF of sub-100 nm beads in widefield and derive the OTF cutoff, confirming it is near 2NA/λ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The highest-resolution technique is always the best choice.
quiz.explanation: 以 100 nm 以下的螢光珠在寬場模式量 PSF 並求 OTF 截止頻率，確認接近 2NA/λ；同一樣品以 SIM 重建後在傅立葉譜上確認支援範圍擴大到約兩倍；在固定的稀疏單分子樣品上重複定位同一分子 100 次，量位置標準差並與 s/√N 比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the PSF of sub-100 nm beads in widefield and derive the OTF cutoff, confirming it is near 2NA/λ; reconstruct the same sample with SIM and confirm in the Fourier spectrum that support has roughly doubled; on a fixed sparse single-molecule sample localize one molecule 100 times, measure the positional standard deviation and compare with s/√N. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 繞射極限與三種繞過策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The diffraction limit and three ways around it: failure diagnosis

steps.title: STED 損耗飽和與解析度定律：原理與系統邊界

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Doughnut depletion beam and saturation” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: STED 在激發光點上疊加一束中心為零的甜甜圈形損耗光，波長位於螢光光譜紅端，以受激發射把激發態分子在發出螢光前帶回基態。損耗效果隨強度飽和：局部強度遠大於飽和強度 I_sat 時幾乎所有分子都被關掉，只剩甜甜圈零點附近的分子能發光，有效光點依 d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) 縮小，原理上沒有下限。實務限制來自三處：零點品質（中心殘餘強度會壓低訊號）、損耗光造成的漂白與熱，以及激發與損耗光束在三維中的重合精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「甜甜圈損耗光與飽和強度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: STED overlays the excitation spot with a doughnut-shaped depletion beam whose centre is zero, at a wavelength on the red edge of the emission spectrum, returning excited molecules to the ground state by stimulated emission before they fluoresce. Depletion saturates with intensity: where local intensity far exceeds the saturation intensity I_sat nearly every molecule is switched off and only those near the doughnut zero can emit, so the effective spot shrinks as d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) with no lower bound in principle. Practical limits come from three places: the quality of the zero, since residual intensity there suppresses signal; bleaching and heating by the depletion light; and the three-dimensional overlap accuracy of the excitation and depletion beams. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doughnut depletion beam and saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: STED 損耗飽和與解析度定律：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「甜甜圈損耗光與飽和強度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Doughnut depletion beam and saturation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = 640 nm、NA = 1.4：d₀ = 229 nm。要 40 nm 需 √(1 + I/I_sat) = 5.71，I/I_sat ≈ 31.7；I/I_sat = 10 只有 69 nm，100 可到 23 nm。零點品質以 η = 1/(1 + I/I_sat) 近似：甜甜圈中心殘留峰值 1% 的強度時中心 I/I_sat ≈ 0.32，訊號只剩 76%；殘留 3% 時剩 51%，解析度不變但訊號減半。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At λ = 640 nm and NA = 1.4, d₀ = 229 nm. Approximating zero quality with η = 1/(1 + I/I_sat): a residual of 1% of peak at the doughnut centre gives I/I_sat ≈ 0.32 there and only 76% of signal remains; a 3% residual leaves 51%, halving signal with no gain in resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 80 nm 金奈米粒子在反射模式掃描損耗光，直接量甜甜圈剖面與中心殘留百分比；以螢光珠或已知間距的 DNA 摺紙樣品在多個損耗功率下量有效光點 FWHM，擬合 d 對 √(1 + I/I_sat) 的關係求 I_sat；再量激發與損耗光束中心的三維偏移，確認小於數十奈米。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the depletion beam over 80 nm gold nanoparticles in reflection to measure the doughnut profile and central residual directly; measure effective spot FWHM on beads or DNA origami of known spacing at several depletion powers and fit d against √(1 + I/I_sat) to obtain I_sat; then measure the 3D offset between excitation and depletion beam centres, confirming it is below a few tens of nanometres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 單分子定位需要絕大多數分子處於暗態：光活化螢光蛋白（PALM）由紫光逐次打開，有機染料（dSTORM）則在含硫醇與除氧系統的緩衝液中進入長壽命暗態，再隨機回到亮態。每個分子亮著的時間比例稱為佔空比，它決定單位面積可容許的最大標記密度；奈奎斯特準則卻要求標記間距不大於目標解析度的一半，兩者互相拉扯。標記本身也有大小：一抗加二抗把螢光團放在離目標蛋白十幾奈米外，造成連結誤差，奈米抗體或自標記標籤等小型標記可大幅縮小它。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光開關染料與標記密度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Single-molecule localization needs nearly all molecules dark: photoactivatable fluorescent proteins (PALM) are switched on a few at a time by violet light, while organic dyes (dSTORM) enter long-lived dark states in buffers with thiols and oxygen scavenging and return stochastically. Labels also have size: primary plus secondary antibodies place the fluorophore over ten nanometres from the target protein, a linkage error that small labels such as nanobodies or self-labeling tags shrink greatly. steps.title: 螢光團、閃爍緩衝液與標記密度：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photoswitchable dyes and labeling density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：目標解析度 20 nm 需標記間距 ≤ 10 nm，即 ≥ 1/(0.01 µm)² = 10⁴ 個/µm²。一個繞射面積約 (0.25 µm)² = 0.0625 µm² 內就有 625 個標記，要每幀至多一個亮著，佔空比必須 ≤ 1/625 = 1.6×10⁻³。若染料佔空比為 10⁻³（教學假設），每個標記在 M 幀內至少亮一次的機率為 1 − e^(−M/1000)，要 95% 覆蓋需 M ≈ 3000 幀。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 20 nm target resolution needs label spacing ≤ 10 nm, that is ≥ 1/(0.01 µm)² = 10⁴ labels/µm². With a dye duty cycle of 10⁻³ (teaching assumption), the probability that a label lights at least once in M frames is 1 − e^(−M/1000), so 95% coverage needs M ≈ 3000 frames. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在稀疏標記樣品上統計每個分子的亮態與暗態時間，求佔空比與每次閃爍的光子數分布；在微管等密集結構上量相鄰定位重疊造成的誤合併率；以已知拷貝數的標準結構比較偵測到的分子數，估計標記效率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On sparsely labelled samples measure on-state and off-state times per molecule to obtain the duty cycle and the photon-count distribution per blink; on dense structures such as microtubules measure the rate of false merges caused by overlapping neighbours; compare detected molecule counts with a standard structure of known copy number to estimate labeling efficiency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 照明幾何、背景與偵測器選擇：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Illumination geometry, background and detector choice: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TIRF 物鏡與單光子相機」如何決定超解析螢光顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TIRF objective and low-noise camera” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定位精度不只由光子數決定，背景與像素化同樣重要。全內反射（TIRF）照明以超過臨界角的入射在玻片表面形成漸逝波，只激發玻片上方約百奈米內的分子，大幅降低背景；斜照（HILO）則以略小於臨界角的傾斜光片照到細胞較深處。偵測器方面，EMCCD 以電子倍增壓過讀出雜訊，但倍增的隨機性帶來 √2 的過量雜訊因子，等效於光子數減半；sCMOS 讀出雜訊僅約 1 到 2 個電子，但每個像素的偏移與增益不同，必須逐像素校正。像素換算到樣品端約等於 PSF 標準差時精度最佳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TIRF 物鏡與單光子相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Localization precision depends not only on photon count but equally on background and pixelation. Total internal reflection (TIRF) illumination beyond the critical angle creates an evanescent wave at the coverslip that excites only molecules within about a hundred nanometres, sharply reducing background, while highly inclined illumination (HILO) uses a tilted sheet just below the critical angle to reach deeper into the cell. Among detectors, an EMCCD beats read noise by electron multiplication but its randomness adds an excess-noise factor of √2, equivalent to halving the photon count; an sCMOS has only 1 to 2 electrons of read noise but every pixel has its own offset and gain and must be calibrated individually. Precision is best when the pixel referred to the sample is about the PSF standard deviation. steps.title: 漂移校正與焦距鎖定：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Drift correction and focus lock: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基準金粒子與焦距鎖定」如何決定超解析螢光顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fiducial gold particles and focus lock” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單分子定位要拍數千到數萬幀、耗時數分鐘，而載物台、物鏡與樣品座構成的結構迴路會隨溫度漂移數十奈米，遠大於定位精度。橫向漂移有兩種校正方式：在樣品中放入不會漂白的金奈米粒子或多色螢光珠作為基準點逐幀追蹤，或把定位資料切成時間段做影像互相關。軸向則以紅外光在玻片界面的反射建立主動焦距鎖定，否則失焦不只讓 PSF 變胖，3D 定位的高度也會整體偏移。STED 與 SIM 單張影像較快，但多色或長時間取像同樣需要漂移紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基準金粒子與焦距鎖定」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Single-molecule localization records thousands to tens of thousands of frames over minutes, while the structural loop of stage, objective and sample holder drifts tens of nanometres with temperature, far beyond the localization precision. Lateral drift is corrected in two ways: non-bleaching gold nanoparticles or multicolour beads in the sample serve as fiducials tracked frame by frame, or the localizations are cut into time segments and cross-correlated. Axially, an infrared beam reflected from the coverslip interface provides an active focus lock; without it defocus not only fattens the PSF but shifts 3D heights wholesale. STED and SIM frames are faster, but multicolour or long acquisitions still need a drift record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fiducial gold particles and focus lock”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：結構迴路 50 mm、鋁 CTE 23 ppm/K、溫度每分鐘變 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min；20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s 累積約 77 nm，是 4.8 nm 定位精度的 16 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 mm structural loop in aluminium (CTE 23 ppm/K) with temperature changing 0.02 K per minute drifts about 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min; 20 000 frames at 10 ms take 200 s and accumulate about 77 nm, sixteen times the 4.8 nm precision.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載物台夠穩固就不需要漂移校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 漂移校正與焦距鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drift correction and focus lock: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基準金粒子與焦距鎖定」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fiducial gold particles and focus lock” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：結構迴路 50 mm、鋁 CTE 23 ppm/K、溫度每分鐘變 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min；20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s 累積約 77 nm，是 4.8 nm 定位精度的 16 倍。以每幀 5×10⁴ 光子的金粒子為基準，σ_f ≈ 94/√50000 ≈ 0.42 nm；若改用互相關、每 1000 幀一段，只有 20 個取樣點，段內 3.8 nm 的漂移只能靠內插。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 mm structural loop in aluminium (CTE 23 ppm/K) with temperature changing 0.02 K per minute drifts about 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min; 20 000 frames at 10 ms take 200 s and accumulate about 77 nm, sixteen times the 4.8 nm precision. A gold fiducial giving 5×10⁴ photons per frame has σ_f ≈ 94/√50000 ≈ 0.42 nm; cross-correlation in 1000-frame segments yields only 20 samples, and the 3.8 nm of drift within each segment must be interpolated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在固定的螢光珠樣品上不做校正連續取像 10 分鐘，量 x、y、z 漂移對時間的曲線；開啟基準點校正後重複，殘差標準差應小於 1.5 nm；比較焦距鎖定開與關時的 z 漂移，並在 3D 模式下以已知高度的珠確認高度偏移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a fixed bead sample for 10 minutes without correction and plot x, y and z drift against time; repeat with fiducial correction on, expecting a residual standard deviation below 1.5 nm; compare z drift with the focus lock on and off, and in 3D mode confirm height offsets with beads at known heights.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 漂移校正與焦距鎖定：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基準金粒子與焦距鎖定」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fiducial gold particles and focus lock” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在固定的螢光珠樣品上不做校正連續取像 10 分鐘，量 x、y、z 漂移對時間的曲線；開啟基準點校正後重複，殘差標準差應小於 1.5 nm；比較焦距鎖定開與關時的 z 漂移，並在 3D 模式下以已知高度的珠確認高度偏移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image a fixed bead sample for 10 minutes without correction and plot x, y and z drift against time; repeat with fiducial correction on, expecting a residual standard deviation below 1.5 nm; compare z drift with the focus lock on and off, and in 3D mode confirm height offsets with beads at known heights. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漂移校正與焦距鎖定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drift correction and focus lock" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
定位精度就是超解析影像的解析度。
選用的基準螢光珠在長時間照射下逐漸漂白，後段幀的基準定位精度變差，校正把雜訊注入整個資料集，影像後半段變模糊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Localization precision equals the resolution of the super-resolution image.

The fiducial beads chosen slowly bleach under long illumination, their localization precision degrades in late frames, the correction injects noise into the whole dataset and the second half of the image blurs.
quiz.explanation: 選用的基準螢光珠在長時間照射下逐漸漂白，後段幀的基準定位精度變差，校正把雜訊注入整個資料集，影像後半段變模糊；若不檢查基準點光子數隨時間的變化，會誤判為樣品品質問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The fiducial beads chosen slowly bleach under long illumination, their localization precision degrades in late frames, the correction injects noise into the whole dataset and the second half of the image blurs; without checking fiducial photon counts over time this is misdiagnosed as poor sample quality. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 解析度誤差預算與奈奎斯特取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」如何決定超解析螢光顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resolution budget and FRC curve” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定位影像的實際解析度是多個獨立誤差的平方和：定位精度、漂移校正殘差、標記連結誤差與雙色配準誤差，並受標記密度的奈奎斯特極限約束，單看定位精度會嚴重高估解析度。傅立葉環相關（FRC）把資料分成兩半各自重建，比較兩者在各空間頻率的相關性，以 1/7 閾值給出可與預算比較的解析度；若 FRC 遠差於預算，表示有未列入的誤差來源，例如同一分子重複計數或漂移殘差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The real resolution of a localization image is the root-sum-square of independent errors, namely localization precision, drift-correction residual, label linkage error and two-colour registration error, and it is further bounded by the Nyquist limit of labeling density, so localization precision alone grossly overstates resolution. Fourier ring correlation (FRC) splits the data into two halves, reconstructs each and compares their correlation at every spatial frequency, giving at the 1/7 threshold a resolution comparable with the budget; an FRC far worse than the budget reveals an unlisted error such as repeated counting of one molecule or drift residual. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resolution budget and FRC curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：σ_定位 4.8 nm、漂移殘差 1.5 nm、一抗加二抗連結誤差 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm：σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm；改用奈米抗體（連結 2 nm）σ ≈ 6.2 nm，FWHM ≈ 15 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 4.8 nm localization, 1.5 nm drift residual, 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration, σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm; nanobodies with 2 nm linkage give σ ≈ 6.2 nm and FWHM ≈ 15 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「定位精度就是超解析影像的解析度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Localization precision equals the resolution of the super-resolution image." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Resolution budget and FRC curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 解析度誤差預算與奈奎斯特取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resolution budget and FRC curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ_定位 4.8 nm、漂移殘差 1.5 nm、一抗加二抗連結誤差 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm：σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm；改用奈米抗體（連結 2 nm）σ ≈ 6.2 nm，FWHM ≈ 15 nm。23 nm 解析度需標記間距 ≤ 11.7 nm，即 ≥ 7.3×10³ 個/µm²；若實際只有 2000 個/µm²，平均間距 22 nm，奈奎斯特解析度僅 45 nm，瓶頸變成標記而非光學。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 4.8 nm localization, 1.5 nm drift residual, 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration, σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm; nanobodies with 2 nm linkage give σ ≈ 6.2 nm and FWHM ≈ 15 nm. A 23 nm resolution needs label spacing ≤ 11.7 nm, at least 7.3×10³ labels/µm²; with only 2000 labels/µm² the mean spacing is 22 nm and the Nyquist resolution only 45 nm, so labeling rather than optics becomes the bottleneck. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把定位資料依奇偶幀分成兩半，計算 FRC 曲線與 1/7 閾值的交點；與預算 FWHM 比較，差距超過 30% 時逐項檢查重複計數、漂移與配準；在已知形狀的結構上量標記密度並換算奈奎斯特解析度；把預算表、FRC 與密度一起寫入報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Split the localizations into odd and even frames, compute the FRC curve and its crossing of the 1/7 threshold; compare with the budget FWHM and, if they differ by more than 30%, check repeated counting, drift and registration in turn; measure labeling density on a structure of known shape and convert it to a Nyquist resolution; report the budget table, FRC and density together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 解析度誤差預算與奈奎斯特取樣：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「解析度預算與 FRC 曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Resolution budget and FRC curve” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把定位資料依奇偶幀分成兩半，計算 FRC 曲線與 1/7 閾值的交點；與預算 FWHM 比較，差距超過 30% 時逐項檢查重複計數、漂移與配準；在已知形狀的結構上量標記密度並換算奈奎斯特解析度；把預算表、FRC 與密度一起寫入報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Split the localizations into odd and even frames, compute the FRC curve and its crossing of the 1/7 threshold; compare with the budget FWHM and, if they differ by more than 30%, check repeated counting, drift and registration in turn; measure labeling density on a structure of known shape and convert it to a Nyquist resolution; report the budget table, FRC and density together. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：論文宣稱 10 nm 解析度，依據只是定位精度的中位數；實際標記密度每平方微米約 300 個，奈奎斯特解析度約 115 nm，所謂的奈米結構是稀疏取樣下的隨機點群，後續研究無法重現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A paper claims 10 nm resolution based only on median localization precision; the actual labeling density is about 300 per square micrometre, a Nyquist resolution near 115 nm, so the reported nanostructures are random point clusters from sparse sampling and later studies cannot reproduce them.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 論文宣稱 10 nm 解析度，依據只是定位精度的中位數；實際標記密度每平方微米約 300 個，奈奎斯特解析度約 115 nm，所謂的奈米結構是稀疏取樣下的隨機點群，後續研究無法重現。
knowledge.textEn: A paper claims 10 nm resolution based only on median localization precision; the actual labeling density is about 300 per square micrometre, a Nyquist resolution near 115 nm, so the reported nanostructures are random point clusters from sparse sampling and later studies cannot reproduce them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「解析度誤差預算與奈奎斯特取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 論文宣稱 10 nm 解析度，依據只是定位精度的中位數。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。
optionsEn: A paper claims 10 nm resolution based only on median localization precision.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
The highest-resolution technique is always the best choice.
quiz.explanation: 論文宣稱 10 nm 解析度，依據只是定位精度的中位數；實際標記密度每平方微米約 300 個，奈奎斯特解析度約 115 nm，所謂的奈米結構是稀疏取樣下的隨機點群，後續研究無法重現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A paper claims 10 nm resolution based only on median localization precision; the actual labeling density is about 300 per square micrometre, a Nyquist resolution near 115 nm, so the reported nanostructures are random point clusters from sparse sampling and later studies cannot reproduce them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合」與「標準樣品驗收與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration" and "Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「技術選擇與時間解析度」如何決定超解析螢光顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Technique choice and temporal resolution” determines the key performance of “Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 三種超解析方法在系統層級的取捨不同：SIM 用低強度寬場照明、只需數張原始影像，最適合活細胞動態，但解析度只到約兩倍；STED 是點掃描，可直接看到結果，但視野越大越慢，損耗光強度高；單分子定位解析度最高，卻需要數萬幀、特殊緩衝液與通常固定的樣品。整合時要把生物問題的時間尺度、結構尺寸與樣品可承受的光劑量放在同一張表上比較，再決定照明、偵測、焦距鎖定與重建軟體的組合；在同一平台整合多種模式時，共用的物鏡與偵測器必須同時滿足各模式。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「技術選擇與時間解析度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The three methods trade differently at system level: SIM uses low-intensity widefield illumination and only a handful of raw frames, best for live-cell dynamics but limited to about twofold; STED scans a point and shows results directly, but slows with field size and uses intense depletion light; single-molecule localization gives the highest resolution but needs tens of thousands of frames, special buffers and usually fixed samples. Integration puts the biological time scale, structure size and tolerable light dose in one table, then chooses the combination of illumination, detection, focus lock and reconstruction software; when one platform hosts several modes, the shared objective and detectors must satisfy all of them. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Technique choice and temporal resolution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：SIM 2D 需 3 角度 × 3 相位 = 9 張，每張 10 ms 共 90 ms（約 11 Hz）；STORM 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s；STED 5×5 µm 以 20 nm 像素、每點 10 µs 共 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz); STORM takes 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s; STED over 5×5 µm with 20 nm pixels and 10 µs dwell takes 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The highest-resolution technique is always the best choice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「技術選擇與時間解析度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Technique choice and temporal resolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration" is correct?
options: 解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。
三種超解析方法在系統層級的取捨不同：SIM 用低強度寬場照明、只需數張原始影像，最適合活細胞動態，但解析度只到約兩倍。

If images look sharp, scale and resolution must be correct.

quiz.explanationEn: The three methods trade differently at system level: SIM uses low-intensity widefield illumination and only a handful of raw frames, best for live-cell dynamics but limited to about twofold; STED scans a point and shows results directly, but slows with field size and uses intense depletion light; single-molecule localization gives the highest resolution but needs tens of thousands of frames, special buffers and usually fixed samples. steps.title: 技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「技術選擇與時間解析度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Technique choice and temporal resolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：SIM 2D 需 3 角度 × 3 相位 = 9 張，每張 10 ms 共 90 ms（約 11 Hz）；STORM 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s；STED 5×5 µm 以 20 nm 像素、每點 10 µs 共 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s。以 1 µm/s 移動的囊泡為例：SIM 一張期間移動 90 nm，與其解析度相當；STED 單張期間移動 625 nm，造成形變；STORM 期間移動 200 µm，完全不可行。典型照射強度量級：SIM 約 10 到 100 W/cm²，dSTORM 約 1 到 10 kW/cm²，STED 損耗光峰值更高。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz); STORM takes 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s; STED over 5×5 µm with 20 nm pixels and 10 µs dwell takes 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s. For a vesicle moving at 1 µm/s, it moves 90 nm during one SIM image, comparable to SIM resolution, 625 nm during one STED frame, causing distortion, and 200 µm during STORM, which is hopeless. Typical intensity orders: SIM about 10 to 100 W/cm², dSTORM about 1 to 10 kW/cm², STED depletion peaks higher still. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線；以移動中的標準樣品量運動造成的影像形變；把量得的時間解析度、可承受劑量與解析度放入決策表，與生物問題的需求逐項比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each candidate technique run a phototoxicity test on the same live-cell sample, such as mitochondrial morphology or cell-division delay versus total dose; measure motion-induced distortion on a moving reference sample; enter the measured temporal resolution, tolerable dose and resolution into a decision table and check each against the needs of the biological question.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: 2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz); STORM takes 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s; STED over 5×5 µm with 20 nm pixels and 10 µs dwell takes 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s. For a vesicle moving at 1 µm/s, it moves 90 nm during one SIM image, comparable to SIM resolution, 625 nm during one STED frame, causing distortion, and 200 µm during STORM, which is hopeless. Typical intensity orders: SIM about 10 to 100 W/cm², dSTORM about 1 to 10 kW/cm², STED depletion peaks higher still.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration", which statement holds?
options: STED 解析度只由損耗光功率決定，功率越大越好。
只要光子夠多，背景高低不影響定位精度。
SIM 2D 需 3 角度 × 3 相位 = 9 張，每張 10 ms 共 90 ms（約 11 Hz）。
optionsEn: STED resolution depends only on depletion power; more is always better.
With enough photons, background does not affect localization precision.
2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz).
quiz.explanation: SIM 2D 需 3 角度 × 3 相位 = 9 張，每張 10 ms 共 90 ms（約 11 Hz）；STORM 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s；STED 5×5 µm 以 20 nm 像素、每點 10 µs 共 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz); STORM takes 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s; STED over 5×5 µm with 20 nm pixels and 10 µs dwell takes 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「技術選擇與時間解析度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Technique choice and temporal resolution” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線；以移動中的標準樣品量運動造成的影像形變；把量得的時間解析度、可承受劑量與解析度放入決策表，與生物問題的需求逐項比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For each candidate technique run a phototoxicity test on the same live-cell sample, such as mitochondrial morphology or cell-division delay versus total dose; measure motion-induced distortion on a moving reference sample; enter the measured temporal resolution, tolerable dose and resolution into a decision table and check each against the needs of the biological question. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以 STORM 研究活細胞中快速移動的膜蛋白聚集，200 秒取像期間分子早已擴散，重建出的聚集體其實是運動軌跡的疊加；改用 SIM 或單粒子追蹤才是正確的工具選擇。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: STORM is used to study fast-moving membrane-protein clusters in live cells; the molecules diffuse far during the 200 s acquisition and the reconstructed clusters are superimposed trajectories, when SIM or single-particle tracking was the right tool.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線；以移動中的標準樣品量運動造成的影像形變；把量得的時間解析度、可承受劑量與解析度放入決策表，與生物問題的需求逐項比對。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration"?
options: 對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
載物台夠穩固就不需要漂移校正。
optionsEn: For each candidate technique run a phototoxicity test on the same live-cell sample, such as mitochondrial morphology or cell-division delay versus total dose.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A rigid enough stage makes drift correction unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線；以移動中的標準樣品量運動造成的影像形變；把量得的時間解析度、可承受劑量與解析度放入決策表，與生物問題的需求逐項比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For each candidate technique run a phototoxicity test on the same live-cell sample, such as mitochondrial morphology or cell-division delay versus total dose; measure motion-induced distortion on a moving reference sample; enter the measured temporal resolution, tolerable dose and resolution into a decision table and check each against the needs of the biological question. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「技術選擇與時間解析度」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Technique choice and temporal resolution” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以 STORM 研究活細胞中快速移動的膜蛋白聚集，200 秒取像期間分子早已擴散，重建出的聚集體其實是運動軌跡的疊加；改用 SIM 或單粒子追蹤才是正確的工具選擇。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: STORM is used to study fast-moving membrane-protein clusters in live cells; the molecules diffuse far during the 200 s acquisition and the reconstructed clusters are superimposed trajectories, when SIM or single-particle tracking was the right tool. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整合時要把生物問題的時間尺度、結構尺寸與樣品可承受的光劑量放在同一張表上比較，再決定照明、偵測、焦距鎖定與重建軟體的組合；在同一平台整合多種模式時，共用的物鏡與偵測器必須同時滿足各模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Integration puts the biological time scale, structure size and tolerable light dose in one table, then chooses the combination of illumination, detection, focus lock and reconstruction software; when one platform hosts several modes, the shared objective and detectors must satisfy all of them.

steps.title: 標準樣品驗收與工程交接：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：染料直接連在摺紙上，連結誤差近零，σ = √(4.8² + 1.5²) ≈ 5.0 nm，兩點 FWHM 約 11.9 nm，40 nm 與 20 nm 奈米尺都應清楚分開；40 nm 尺量得 39.2 ± 2.1 nm（n = 50），尺度偏差 −2%，在 ±3% 允收內。其他門檻：雙色配準殘差 ≤ 3 nm、漂移校正殘差 ≤ 1.5 nm、FRC 解析度與預算 FWHM 23 nm 相差 ≤ 30%（例如量得 28 nm）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.instruction: 依固定順序：熱平衡與焦距鎖定；相機暗場與增益校正；多色珠配準；DNA 摺紙奈米尺取像並統計間距分布；核孔樣品統計環直徑與每環定位數；以奇偶幀分半計算 FRC；所有結果與預算並列填表，超出允收者記錄原因與處置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 驗收只看漂亮的微管影像而沒有量奈米尺，放大率校正錯 5% 未被發現，之後所有距離量測都系統性偏差，包括已發表的蛋白間距；交接紀錄也缺少緩衝液批次，問題發生後無法判斷是光學還是化學造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance looked only at attractive microtubule images and never measured a nanoruler, so a 5% magnification error went unnoticed and every later distance, including published protein spacings, carries a systematic bias; the handoff also lacked buffer batch records, so when problems arise nobody can tell whether optics or chemistry is to blame. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含各雷射的功率密度、緩衝液配方批次與效期、相機逐像素校正檔、配準矩陣與 FRC 結果，因為任何一項改變都會讓同一個數字代表不同的品質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff must hold each laser's power density, buffer recipe batch and shelf life, per-pixel camera calibration, registration matrices and FRC results, because a change in any of them makes the same number mean a different quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「影像看起來夠清晰，尺度與解析度就一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If images look sharp, scale and resolution must be correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
